messages:
jordan: Heads up — saw a reproducible throughput cliff on routes that mix variants (fp16 + int8). When fallback fires, batch formation collapses and we go to effective batch size 1 for ~30s. Observed on canary traffic only.

sam: Can you paste the route config and queue policy? My first guess is token_budget enforcement + compat-set mismatch.

jordan: here — route uses compat_set [gpt-large-fp16, gpt-large-q4] with queue_policy `token_budget_target: 32, max_wait_ms: 15`.

priya: quick note: we saw the same pattern when kvcache warmup failed — cache miss bursts create lots of short requests and kill batching. Did you see KV hit-rate dip? :thinking_face:

mia: attaching profiler snippet (copied from perf-bot):
```
continuous_batching_metrics: {
  window_sec: 10,
  avg_batch_size: 1.2,
  p95_batch_size: 1,
  token_budget_enforced: true,
  fallback_count: 237
}
kernel_select: chosen_kernel: aten_attn_fused_v2, fallback_kernel: aten_attn_ref
kv_cache: prefix_hits: 0.13 -> 0.05 (during regression)
latency: p50: 42ms -> 55ms, p95: 120ms -> 138ms
throughput: tokens/s: 12k -> 10.5k
```

sam: that kernel select change is suspicious — `aten_attn_fused_v2` has a higher setup cost for mixed-precision on small batches. If compat routing forces variant switch mid-request, we pay that cost per request.

priya: also, the fallback behavior currently re-enqueues to the front of the queue with a new variant tag. That interacts badly with token_budget_target: small targets + reenqueue => many micro-batches. I think we should avoid front-requeue for variant mismatches.

jordan: agreed. Repro steps I used: replayed 1k requests with 30% q4 variant, 70% fp16 variant, injected a KV miss spike at t=200s. Attached script gist: https://internal/gists/replica-batch-repro

perf-bot: profile summary for thread 1769876543:
- avg_latency_increase: +14.5ms
- batch_size_drop: -82% (for affected window)
- kernel_switches_per_sec: 9.2 -> 14.8
- kv_miss_spike: 0.06 -> 0.28

mia: quick experiment idea: two changes to trial on canary 2: 1) change queue_policy to `reenqueue_to_back: true` for variant_fallback, 2) raise token_budget_target to 64 for compat routes. If that recovers avg_batch_size -> then we know it's the queue interaction.

sam: also try pinning kernel selection to prefer low-setup kernels for short sequences with a threshold: if expected_seq_len < 64 and estimated_batch < 8, use aten_attn_ref_small. Might lose some throughput on big batches but improve stability.

jordan: noted. I'm going to run two parallel canaries: canary-A = increase token_budget_target, canary-B = reenqueue_to_back + kernel pin. Will collect perf-bot traces.

priya: can someone check whether the rollout introduced a subtle change to compat_set resolution order? If resolution switched to prefer int8 variant when cold, that could explain the sudden kernel churn.

mia: I scanned the rollout diffs — kernel selector change was in commit 2f4a1b (runtime/selection): it added heuristic `prefer_quant_for_cpu_bound` which might bias selection earlier than before.

deploy-bot: rolled back canary v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 for subset:user-qa (automated rollback due to error budget spike) :warning:

jordan: thanks — after rollback the batch sizes recovered partially but not fully. So both the selector heuristic and queue policy are contributing.

sam: quick checklist:
- [ ] run canary-A/B today and collect 30m windows
- [ ] add a metric for reenqueue_position to surface front vs back requeues
- [ ] repro with kv miss injection + variant mix locally
- [ ] add gating in kernel selector: avoid high-setup kernels if batch_size_est < 4

priya: I'll own the requeue metric + frontend change to reenqueue_to_back default for variant mismatches. Assigning to @priya.

mia: I'll prototype the kernel pin threshold and test on small sequences.

jordan: I'll run the canaries and share perf-bot snapshots here. If anyone sees a quick win patch, push to canary channel and tag this thread. :eyes:

sam: thanks all. If the canaries are green, follow-up task to update rollout notes and add a regression test that simulates KV miss bursts across compat routes.

perf-bot: logged action: perf/regressions/1769876543 (priority: high)

jordan: closing loop — canary-A (increase token_budget_target) recovered avg_batch_size to 4.8, p95 latency improved by 20ms. Canary-B (reenqueue_to_back + kernel pin) recovered to 6.1 and stabilized kernel switches. Will open PRs for both changes.

sam: awesome — please include the profiler snippet and the kv miss harness in the PR. :thumbsup:

priya: PRs posted: runtime#4823 (reenqueue), runtime#4824 (requeue metric), selector#127 (kernel pin). Linking in the thread.

jordan: assigning follow-ups in the tracker. Thanks everyone.
